## Objectives

1. Look at Imre's place on the high terrace in [Midbarium](../maps/midbarium.md)
2. Reach [The Weathered Rocks](../maps/weathered_rocks.md)

## Rewards

- 31,000 EXP
- 1,060 mesos
- [Travel Ration](../items/travel_ration.md) x10
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Imre](../npcs/imre.md)
